longform.introHeadline: Find Security Weaknesses Before Attackers Do
introParagraphs: Modern web applications handle sensitive data, business-critical workflows, APIs, authentication, payments, and integrations. A single vulnerability can expose customer information, compromise accounts, or interrupt business operations.
Our **Web Application Penetration Testing** service simulates realistic attack scenarios to identify security weaknesses before they can be exploited.
We combine **automated security testing, manual penetration testing, business-logic analysis, and expert validation** to provide findings that your development and security teams can actually act on.
Powered by our AI + Human Penetration Testing Platform: machine-speed analysis guided by expert testers who prove real-world risk.

longform.whatWeTestIntro: Our assessment covers the major security areas of your web application.

testAreas.title: Authentication Security
testAreas.intro: We evaluate how securely users access your application. Testing can include:
testAreas.goal: Prevent unauthorized users from gaining access to accounts.

testAreas.title: Authorization & Access Control
testAreas.intro: Authentication answers **“Who are you?”** Authorization answers **“What are you allowed to do?”** We test whether users can access data or functionality outside their assigned permissions. Examples include:
testAreas.goal: Ensure users can only access the resources and actions they are authorized to use.

testAreas.title: Input Validation & Injection Testing
testAreas.intro: Applications constantly process user-controlled input. We examine how securely that input is handled and test for vulnerabilities such as:
testAreas.goal: Prevent user input from becoming executable commands, scripts, or database queries.

testAreas.title: API Security Testing
testAreas.intro: Modern applications often depend heavily on APIs. We test APIs for weaknesses involving:
testAreas.goal: Protect the services and data powering your web application. API testing is aligned with common OWASP API Security risks.

testAreas.title: Session Management Testing
testAreas.intro: A secure login is not enough if the user session itself can be compromised. We review:
testAreas.goal: Prevent stolen or manipulated sessions from being used to hijack user accounts.

testAreas.title: Business Logic Testing
testAreas.intro: Some of the most serious vulnerabilities cannot be discovered by scanners. Our testers analyze how your application is intended to work and look for ways those workflows could be abused.
testAreas.goal: Protect not only your application code, but also your business processes.

extras.whyNeededText: Cloud-hosted applications change constantly. New identities, APIs, buckets, and services appear with every deploy. A point-in-time checklist scan is not enough — you need a structured assessment that follows how attackers actually move through cloud environments. Built on our AI + Human Penetration Testing Platform.

whyNeededItems.title: Cloud identity is the new perimeter
whyNeededItems.text: Most cloud breaches start with IAM mistakes, over-privileged roles, or leaked credentials — not a classic firewall gap.

whyNeededItems.title: APIs expose the business
whyNeededItems.text: Your application logic now lives behind APIs and gateways. If authz is weak, attackers can reach data without touching the UI.

whyNeededItems.title: Misconfigurations spread quickly
whyNeededItems.text: One public bucket, open security group, or wildcard policy can expose production data across accounts.

whyNeededItems.title: Compliance still requires proof
whyNeededItems.text: Audits and customers expect evidence that cloud controls were tested, validated, and reported with severity.

extras.standardsSubtitle: Our cloud assessments follow CIS, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and MITRE ATT&CK so findings map to frameworks your auditors and customers already use.

faqs.question: How is this different from a pentest?
faqs.answer: Assessments emphasize discovery and prioritization of known weaknesses. Pentests go deeper into manual exploitation and business logic.

faqs.question: Do you validate scanner findings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Important findings are manually reviewed to reduce false positives.

faqs.question: Can this cover cloud assets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cloud resources and misconfigurations can be included in scope.

faqs.question: Is a retest included?
faqs.answer: Critical remediation can be retested as part of the engagement.
